pathAssistantSteps.info: Exit criteria before Renewal Proposed: Amount and Close Date match the contract being renewed and its renewal date, and the customer has confirmed they intend to renew. Owner: the rep who owns the deal.

Exit criteria before Closed Won: the renewal quote is with the customer, and a discount above 20% is approved, not merely submitted - read Approval Status below rather than the email thread. Owner: the rep who owns the deal.
